issues.detail: Hebrew has 'Livni' (לִבְנִי) and 'Shimei' (שִׁמְעִי); Vietnamese renders 'Líp-ni' (correct) but 'Si-mê-y' (incorrect, should be 'Si-mê-i' or similar to match Shimei). The name is slightly altered but still recognizable; however, the order is also reversed: Hebrew lists 'Livni and Shimei', Vietnamese lists 'Líp-ni và Si-mê-y' — order is preserved, so only the name spelling is off. This is a minor name rendering issue, not a substantive swap.
